+import pytest
+from slug import slugify
+
+def test_basic_lowercase():
+    assert slugify("Hello World") == "hello-world"
+
+def test_uppercase_letters():
+    assert slugify("HELLO WORLD") == "hello-world"
+
+def test_mixed_case():
+    assert slugify("HeLLo WoRLd") == "hello-world"
+
+def test_digits():
+    assert slugify("123456") == "123456"
+
+def test_alphanumeric():
+    assert slugify("Test123Example") == "test123example"
+
+def test_punctuation():
+    assert slugify("Hello!") == "hello"
+
+def test_consecutive_runners():
+    assert slugify("Hello...World!!!") == "hello-world"
+
+def test_space_separator():
+    assert slugify("a  b   c") == "a-b-c"
+
+def test_hyphen_separator():
+    assert slugify("a---b--c") == "a-b-c"
+
+def test_boundary_hyphens():
+    assert slugify("-hello-") == "hello"
+
+def test_leading_trailing_mixed():
+    assert slugify("-hello world-!") == "hello-world"
+
+def test_empty_input():
+    assert slugify("") == ""
+
+def test_punctuation_only():
+    assert slugify("!!!@@@") == ""
+
+def test_special_chars():
+    assert slugify("Test,Path\nWith\tSpaces!") == "test-path-with-spaces"
+
+def test_numeric_boundary():
+    assert slugify("1a2b3") == "1a2b3"
+
+def test_all_special_run():
+    assert slugify("!!!...") == ""
+
+def test_single_char_preserved():
+    assert slugify("a") == "a"
